facts.text: An articulated hauler, also called an articulated dump truck (ADT), is an off-road dump truck whose front and rear halves are joined by a hinge that allows the machine to bend in the middle to steer.
facts.quote: An articulated hauler, also called an articulated dump truck (ADT), is an off-road dump truck whose front and rear halves are joined by a hinge so it bends in the middle to steer.

facts.text: During a straight stop on level ground, an articulated hauler behaves like a simple mass.
facts.quote: In a straight stop on level ground an articulated hauler behaves like a simple mass

facts.text: Braking an articulated hauler while turning, on a side slope or at a large articulation angle can make the front and rear halves push on each other, roll or swing.
facts.quote: braking while turning, on a side slope or at a large articulation angle can make the two halves push on each other, roll or swing [Chapter 8]

facts.text: The booklet quotes a Volvo A60 mass of about 44 t empty and 99 t loaded.
facts.quote: The booklet quotes a Volvo A60 at about 44 t empty and 99 t loaded

facts.text: A New South Wales brake example specifies that a 25 t articulated dump truck traveling at 50 km/h needs 3.13 m/s² of deceleration to stop in about 31 m.
facts.quote: a New South Wales brake example in which a 25 t ADT at 50 km/h needs 3.13 m/s² of deceleration to stop in about 31 m [Chapter 8]

facts.text: The forthcoming ISO/PRF 21815-5 treats articulation as its own form of collision-relevant motion.
facts.quote: The forthcoming ISO/PRF 21815-5 treats articulation as its own form of collision-relevant motion [Chapter 8].

facts.text: Only aggregate accident statistics are available for construction-site articulated dump trucks.
facts.quote: Construction-site ADTs have only aggregate accident statistics behind them

facts.text: Published data on jackknife or roll events during automatic braking of articulated off-road machines were not found.
facts.quote: published data on jackknife or roll events during automatic braking of articulated off-road machines were not found [Chapters 4, 8].

facts.text: A simple braking model is not sufficient to represent the hinge of an articulated hauler.
facts.quote: The hinge is one place where a simple braking model is not enough.
